source: Read-only production D1 via Wrangler on September 27, 2026. Selected rows only; Cloudflare response metadata omitted.

status_delivery.query: SELECT check_id,revision,conclusion,state,attempts,available_at,datetime(available_at/1000,'unixepoch') FROM work_status_outbox WHERE run_id='a9b2f077-915f-4877-9e0d-0ca922919417' ORDER BY check_id,revision;
status_delivery.result_selection: Selected revisions 299 and 313 from the ordered response; delivered_utc labels the datetime expression.

snapshots.query: SELECT s.id AS snapshot_id, s.run_id, s.state, pr.baseline_revision, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM visonaut_snapshot_images si WHERE si.snapshot_id=s.id) AS total_images, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM visonaut_snapshot_images si WHERE si.snapshot_id=s.id AND si.copied=1) AS copied_images, op.verified_through FROM visonaut_snapshots s LEFT JOIN visonaut_promotions pr ON pr.snapshot_id=s.id LEFT JOIN operations_promotions op ON op.snapshot_id=s.id WHERE s.id IN ('snapshot-1167c7b4636563614010f8c4b3f5921b1e129befce5002dcf9daff5d8072cccc','snapshot-7e802ead15d67be3bc6d1e77d3588620f27496f9c247f5ac9fbfb4e55774814c');

backup.query: SELECT b.id,b.state,b.failures,b.page_count,b.object_count,b.active_group_id,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM operations_backup_members m WHERE m.backup_id=b.id) AS total_groups,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM operations_backup_members m JOIN operations_backup_groups g ON g.id=m.group_id WHERE m.backup_id=b.id AND g.state='ready') AS ready_groups FROM operations_backups b WHERE b.id='2026-09-27T12Z';

project_pointer.query: SELECT p.id AS project_id,p.snapshot_id,p.baseline_revision,p.promotion_id,p.policy_digest FROM visonaut_projects p JOIN visonaut_snapshots s ON s.project_id=p.id WHERE s.id='snapshot-1167c7b4636563614010f8c4b3f5921b1e129befce5002dcf9daff5d8072cccc';
